maps.name: Demo Valley
maps.author: 3DTD
maps.description: River valley with a village, woods, a bridge and cliffs; two roads lead to the HQ.

maps.name: Mountain Pass
maps.author: 3DTD
maps.description: Hairpins up to a stone village on the pass, a waterfall into a mountain lake, a cable car over the valley. Two spawns meet at the first bend.

maps.name: Witch Marsh
maps.author: 3DTD
maps.description: Boardwalks over a swamp at night, islands with stilt huts and the witch's glowing hut by the HQ. Two spawns come out of the fog.

maps.name: Autumn Keep
maps.author: 3DTD
maps.description: A ruined castle on a hill above red and golden woods. Three roads meet before the gatehouse; the HQ stands in the bailey.

maps.name: Red Canyon
maps.author: 3DTD
maps.description: A branching canyon through a red desert plain. Enemies walk the canyon floor, towers stand on the mesas; the HQ is a temple ruin by an oasis.

maps.name: Archipelago
maps.author: 3DTD
maps.description: Five islands in a clear sea, linked by wooden bridges and a ford. A harbour with a quay, crane and lighthouse below the HQ.

maps.name: Frost Hamlet
maps.author: 3DTD
maps.description: A snowed-in village by a frozen lake on a winter evening. One road runs round the lake, the other straight over the ice.

maps.name: Ember Crater
maps.author: 3DTD
maps.description: A road spirals down a volcano's crater to the HQ on an obsidian island in a lava lake. Three spawns on the outer slopes join the spiral.

maps.name: Twin Gates
maps.author: 3DTD
maps.description: A mirrored coop map at dusk: two castles, two lanes each through the bailey, one shared HQ in the middle. Four spawns.
